authority_boundary: Chronology, git provenance, accepted authority, eligibility, hashes, and aggregation are deterministic. TypeSafe supplies provisional semantic judgments only.

failure_autonomous_reset.failure_statement: A first-event probability theorem is conditional on analyzer, clock, capture, and reset. The missing physical construction is an open scattering/environment mechanism rather than another probability identity.

failure_continuous_action_scale.failure_statement: Classical Euler and KKS normalization alone has not supplied an intrinsic discrete action unit. A quantum bridge must find a global integrality/holonomy mechanism or state the new postulate.

failure_false_casimir.failure_statement: The H^-1 orbit-chart coercivity step failed and the explored A3 space supplied no usable Casimir. A future persistence construction needs a different constrained Hessian, spectral gap, modulation, or admissible representation.

failure_fprime_isolated_saddle.failure_statement: The zero set from F'(zeta)=0 can be a full level. The repaired construction obtains an isolated hyperbolic orbit from a nondegenerate zeta-critical point and indefinite Hessian.

failure_regular_trace_layer.failure_statement: At F'(zeta) nonzero on a regular zeta torus the centralizer flow has no fixed point, so a separatrix layer requiring a hyperbolic fixed orbit cannot form. The failure redirects construction to a zeta-critical point with indefinite Hessian.
